scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/web dev" "pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/api dev" "pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/worker dev"
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/domain build && pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/database build && node scripts/sync-workspace.cjs
scripts.build:backend: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/api build && pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/worker build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/api build && pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/worker build && pnpm --filter @tripsaathi/web build
